# Errors

## This server

Problems the MCP server reports itself, before it sends anything. The hint a tool returns names the specifics.

| Name | Retry later | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `InvalidInput` | no | a parameter is missing or out of range; issues names each field |
| `NotFound` | no | an account the call reads does not exist on this cluster |
| `NotAMint` | no | an address passed as a mint is not a token mint |
| `RateLimited` | yes | the RPC node is rate limiting; call again in a few seconds |
| `Unreachable` | yes | the RPC node could not be reached: the connection was refused, the name did not resolve or the request failed; call again once it is back, and check whether a send landed before sending it again |
| `CertificateUntrusted` | no | this machine does not trust the RPC node's certificate, often because antivirus or a proxy inspects HTTPS |
| `Unfunded` | no | your wallet has no SOL yet; fund it, then try again |
| `Failed` | no | an unexpected error; its message, which may come from the RPC node, is in the untrusted detail |
| `MaybeSent` | no | the transaction may have landed, so it must not be sent again: look its signature up with intent-engine lookup --signature, as the hint says, and send again only once that reports expired |
| `TransactionFailed` | no | the transaction would fail for a reason this client does not name; the node's error is in the untrusted detail and the last log lines in logs |
| `WalletNotConfigured` | no | a wallet tool was called on a server started without --wallet |
| `NoClock` | no | wait was given to a server built without a clock; call again without wait |
| `WalletNotMainnet` | no | the RPC serves mainnet; wallet tools work on devnet, testnet and localnet only |
| `NoWallet` | no | the server has no wallet yet; call solive_wallet_setup first |
| `WalletEmpty` | no | the wallet holds no SOL; fund it from a faucet, then try again |
| `WalletTokenNotAllowed` | no | the server was started with sell limits that do not name this token |
| `WalletTradeLimit` | no | the trade sells more than the server's --wallet-per-trade limit for this token |
| `ReleaseChanged` | no | the release differs from the one previewed: its payee, amount, result, fee or the escrow itself changed; preview it again and show the user |
| `ReleaseTooLarge` | no | this split has too many co-authors to fit in one transaction; pass a lookup_table or reduce recipients as the hint says |
| `WalletBusy` | yes | another server using the same wallet holds its sale record for a moment; call again |
| `WalletHourLimit` | yes | the wallet sold as much of this token in the last hour as the server's --wallet-per-hour limit allows; try later or sell less |
| `AgentNotConfigured` | no | solive_agent_create was called on a server started without --agent |
| `OwnerNotServed` | no | the owner is not in the server's --agent-owners list |
| `BudgetExhausted` | yes | the agent or relayer key reached its hourly lamport budget; try again later |
| `NoFreeNonce` | no | no free nonce is left in the owner's window or the mandate's lane |
| `NoFreeMandateId` | no | this owner already granted this agent as many mandates as the client looks through; revoke one first |
| `NoncePromised` | yes | the nonce is held for another pending request; leave nonce out or ask again later |
| `TooManyPending` | yes | the owner has too many prepared requests waiting; submit some or let them expire |
| `SubmitInFlight` | yes | another request is relaying the same intent; ask again in a moment |
| `RelayerNotConfigured` | no | solive_submit_signed_intent was called on a server started without --relayer |
| `RelayMintNotAccepted` | no | the relayer does not relay intents selling this token |
| `RelayFeeTooLow` | no | the relayer fee is below what this relayer charges for the input token |
| `RelayTooCostly` | no | relaying would cost more lamports than this relayer pays per intent |
| `RelayTooLong` | no | the intent expires later than this relayer accepts |
| `RelayRateLimited` | yes | the owner reached this relayer's hourly intent limit |
| `RelayTooLarge` | no | the signed terms do not fit in one transaction with this relayer |
| `NonceTaken` | no | a different intent already uses this nonce; these signed terms can never be submitted |
| `SignatureInvalid` | no | the signature is not the owner's signature of these exact terms |
| `SignatureMalformed` | no | the signature is not a base58 Ed25519 signature |
| `NotRentPayer` | no | only the wallet that paid an intent's rent may close it; cancel without close |
| `NothingToCrank` | yes | the intent is not yet expired, or settling it pays this cranker nothing |
| `FundingExceedsBounty` | no | recreating the owner's token account costs more than the intent's bounty |
| `OwnerAccountMissing` | no | the owner has no token account that can take the refund; crank with fund_accounts |
| `NotDeliverable` | no | the intent is not an open proof escrow, so no work can be delivered to it |
| `NoSpecUrl` | no | the escrow publishes no spec url, or is not a proof escrow; ask its owner where its acceptance spec lives |
| `NotInvited` | no | pay_to was not invited to the job: its spec is sealed to other wallets |
| `SpecSealed` | no | the spec is sealed to invited wallets, and this server's wallet is not one of them or it has no wallet |
| `SpecUnreadable` | yes | the spec url could not be read this time: it failed or the node answered a temporary error; try again shortly |
| `SpecUnfetchable` | no | the spec url cannot be read: it answered not-found, redirects, is larger than the limit, or is not a public http(s) address; ask the owner for a working spec url and do not retry this one |
| `WorkUnreadable` | yes | the announced work could not be fetched this time: the request failed or the host answered a temporary error; try again shortly |
| `WorkUnfetchable` | no | the announced work cannot be read here: no announcement opens with this wallet's keys, or its url answers not-found, redirects, is larger than the limit or is not a public https address; do not retry it |
| `NotEarliestAnnouncer` | no | another wallet made the first announcement that opens to the delivered work; a release pays that announcement's worker |
| `AnnouncementsIncomplete` | yes | the RPC node does not list every announcement of the escrow yet, or the escrow is closed, so the first one that opens to the work cannot be known; nothing was signed |
| `KeyNotGiven` | no | an earlier announcement is sealed to a key this server was not given, so the first one that opens to the work cannot be known; start the server with mcp --encryption-keypair naming that key's file |
| `EncryptionKeyInvalid` | no | the file mcp --encryption-keypair names is not an encryption key file that profile encryption-key new writes, so nothing sealed to it can be opened; start the server with the right file |
| `NoMessageSigner` | no | the wallet cannot sign messages, and an announcement derives its salt and keys from the wallet's signature; use a key file or give the signature the hint asks for |
| `NoJudgeCases` | no | the spec has no single judge-cases block the ViperJS sandbox can run, so this server judges nothing; save the spec and the work and judge them with the CLI command judge --sandbox docker |
| `NotJudged` | no | the work was not judged: the spec does not match the escrow, the work is not one UTF-8 module, or the ViperJS judge could not run, as the hint says; nothing was approved or sent |
| `NotAnnounced` | no | no announcement to the escrow opens to this work with this wallet's keys, so no release can pay for it |
| `NotReleased` | no | the escrow has no release in its history yet |
| `KeyInUse` | no | this wallet signs on a Ledger and judges open escrows, whose announcements only its encryption key opens; rotate the key instead of removing it, or wait until they close |
| `NotRefutable` | no | the announcements named cannot refute this release: the hint says why; nothing was sent |
| `NothingToReclaim` | no | none of this wallet's announcements can close now: each belongs to an open escrow, is kept for the refutation window, can still refute a paid release, or holds a split share until it is claimed; the hint says which |
| `NotARelease` | no | the transaction named as the release is not a release of this escrow |
| `ReleaseUnread` | yes | the RPC node could not return the named release transaction; call again in a few seconds |
| `HistoryLagging` | yes | the RPC node has not returned every transaction the call reads yet; call again in a few seconds |
| `OtherLifecycle` | no | the named release belongs to an earlier lifecycle of this escrow address, which was closed and made again at the same nonce, so it is not a release of the escrow there now |
| `ConfirmMismatch` | yes | the second RPC node the server was started with, by --confirm-url, reports another genesis hash, escrow, announcement list or first announcer than the first, or could not be read, so nothing was signed or sent; call again once both nodes agree |
| `NeverSettles` | no | no release of this escrow could pay: after the judge fee, too little is left for the rounded-up protocol and partner fees; escrow more or lower the judge fee, as the hint says |
| `ClaimListTooLarge` | no | the escrow and the claim list its sealed spec sets do not fit in one transaction, and a Ledger signs only the one transaction it previewed; seal the spec to fewer workers, or escrow without claims and open them with intent-engine claims open --workers, which sends the list in parts |
| `Ledger` | no | the wallet's Ledger did not sign: it was rejected on the device, or the device is locked, unplugged or not in the Solana app; nothing was sent, and the hint says which |
| `NoFeePayer` | no | the wallet is a Ledger, which signs only the release message, and the server was started without --fee-payer, the key file that signs and pays the release transaction |
| `DeviceUnpreviewed` | no | the wallet is a Ledger, which signs only the transaction a preview of the same arguments showed by message_hash: no such preview is kept, it expired, or this tool sends several at once; preview again, or send each piece with its own preview |
| `HistoryTooLong` | no | the history a Ledger judge's check depends on could not be read in full, so the release is refused rather than decided from part of it; use an RPC node that keeps the full ledger |

## Engine program

| Code | Name | Retry later | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6000 | `Overflow` | no | an amount is too large for the arithmetic; use smaller amounts |
| 6001 | `DivideByZero` | no | the arithmetic divided by zero; validated order terms never reach this, so rebuild the transaction with this server |
| 6002 | `Truncated` | no | the instruction data was cut short; rebuild the transaction with this server |
| 6003 | `NonCanonical` | no | the instruction data was not encoded canonically; rebuild the transaction with this server |
| 6004 | `UnknownKind` | no | the intent kind is not one the program knows; use swap, limit, dutch or attested |
| 6005 | `UnknownStatus` | no | the intent holds a status this version does not know; update to the latest @intent-engine/cli and read it again |
| 6006 | `InvalidParams` | no | the order terms are inconsistent; check amounts are non-zero and the auction times are ordered |
| 6007 | `AmountMismatch` | no | the amounts do not match what the intent escrows; read the intent again and use its remaining amount |
| 6008 | `InsufficientOutput` | yes | the fill pays less than the intent requires right now; check what it requires with intent-engine quote --owner &lt;address&gt; --nonce &lt;n&gt; |
| 6009 | `InvalidTransition` | no | the intent is not in a state that allows this; read its status with intent-engine show intent --owner &lt;address&gt; --nonce &lt;n&gt; |
| 6010 | `IntentExpired` | no | the intent has expired and can no longer be filled; its owner can still cancel it; anyone can expire it with intent-engine expire --owner &lt;address&gt; --nonce &lt;n&gt; |
| 6011 | `NotExpired` | yes | the intent has not expired yet; wait until its expiry time and try again |
| 6012 | `NonceUsed` | no | this nonce is already used; omit the nonce so the next free one is chosen |
| 6013 | `NonceOutOfWindow` | no | this nonce is outside the owner's 256-nonce window or inside the agent nonce lanes; omit the nonce so the next free one is chosen |
| 6014 | `NonceRegression` | no | the nonce base can only move forward |
| 6015 | `Unauthorized` | no | a signer or a named account does not match the one recorded on-chain (owner, rent payer, mandate agent, admin, guardian or upgrade authority); let this server pick the accounts and sign with the recorded key |
| 6016 | `CreatePaused` | yes | creating intents is paused by the guardian or admin; try again later; intent-engine show config shows the pause bits in paused |
| 6017 | `KindDisabled` | no | this intent kind is not enabled; intent-engine show config shows the enabled kinds as bits in enabledKinds |
| 6018 | `UnknownKindBits` | no | the kind mask names kinds the program does not know |
| 6019 | `InvalidPauseFlags` | no | the pause flags are empty or name pauses the program does not know; use create, fill or all |
| 6020 | `FeeTooHigh` | no | the configured fee exceeds the program's maximum |
| 6021 | `NotPendingAdmin` | no | only the proposed admin can accept the admin role |
| 6022 | `ExpiryNotInFuture` | no | the expiry must be later than the current chain time; use a later expiry |
| 6023 | `SameMint` | no | the input and output mints must differ |
| 6024 | `MintNotAllowed` | no | this mint cannot be used: it has a token extension the program refuses |
| 6025 | `RefundNotCanonical` | no | refunds go only to the owner's canonical token account; let this server pick accounts |
| 6026 | `ReceiverNotAllowed` | no | the receiver account is not owned by the named receiver authority, the authority is an engine account, or (for a mandate) the receiver is not an account the owner controls |
| 6027 | `AuctionOutlivesExpiry` | no | the dutch auction must end at or before the intent expires |
| 6028 | `FillPaused` | yes | fills are paused by the guardian or admin, and with them new claims and stand-by joins; try again later; intent-engine show config shows the pause bits in paused |
| 6029 | `FeeAccountNotCanonical` | no | a fee must go to its payee's canonical token account (the treasury's, the agent's or the judge's); let this server pick it |
| 6030 | `FeeAccountMissing` | no | a fee account was not passed: the treasury's, agent's or judge's at fill, or the relayer's at a signed create; create that token account and pass it |
| 6031 | `SolverOutputNotAllowed` | no | the solver's output account is not acceptable for this fill |
| 6032 | `SigProgram` | no | the signature instruction must come from the Ed25519 program |
| 6033 | `SigHeader` | no | the Ed25519 instruction is malformed; rebuild it with this server |
| 6034 | `SigPubkey` | no | the signature was made by a different key than the owner |
| 6035 | `SigMessage` | no | the signed message does not match this intent; sign the exact message solive_prepare_signed_intent returns on a server started with --relayer |
| 6036 | `KindMismatch` | no | the instruction does not match the intent's kind |
| 6037 | `ResultOutOfBounds` | no | the attested result is outside the intent's bounds |
| 6038 | `SigMissing` | no | the Ed25519 signature instruction is missing; rebuild the transaction with this server |
| 6039 | `InvalidDomain` | no | the config domain must not be zero; init-config takes it from the RPC's genesis hash, so point --url at the cluster you set up |
| 6040 | `SignatureExpired` | no | the signed intent passed its submit-by time; ask the owner to sign a new one |
| 6041 | `FlashCpi` | no | a flash fill cannot be started from inside another program |
| 6042 | `FlashEndProgram` | no | the flash fill must end with this program's end_fill |
| 6043 | `FlashEndDiscriminator` | no | the flash fill's closing instruction is not end_fill |
| 6044 | `FlashEndIntent` | no | the flash fill ends a different intent than it began |
| 6045 | `FlashEndOrder` | no | the flash fill's begin and end are out of order |
| 6046 | `ReceiverCannotReceive` | no | the receiver token account cannot receive: frozen, closed, not initialized, for another mint or owner, or with an extension other than ImmutableOwner; use another receiver |
| 6047 | `RefundCannotReceive` | no | the refund account cannot take the refund: frozen, for another mint or owner, or with a foreign delegate, close authority or extension; refund to another account the owner controls, or wait for a frozen one to be thawed |
| 6048 | `FeeAboveBound` | no | the current fees exceed the bound the solver accepted |
| 6049 | `ExtTooLong` | no | the extension data is too long |
| 6050 | `ExtMalformed` | no | the extension data is malformed: badly encoded, tags unsorted or repeated, or a partner with a zero key or zero bps |
| 6051 | `ExtUnknown` | no | the extension data holds a field the program does not know |
| 6052 | `FlagsUnknown` | no | the intent flags name options the program does not know; leave flags unset |
| 6053 | `FillKindDisabled` | no | the admin stopped fills of this kind, and with them new claims and stand-by joins; intent-engine show config shows the stopped kinds as bits in fillDisabledKinds |
| 6054 | `UnsupportedVersion` | no | an account has a version this program does not support |
| 6055 | `AmountInMismatch` | no | the fill must sell exactly the intent's remaining amount; read the intent again |
| 6056 | `EpochRegression` | no | the signing epoch can only move forward |
| 6057 | `TreasuryMismatch` | no | the treasury account must be the configured fee recipient; let this server pick it |
| 6058 | `CrankBountyTooHigh` | no | the crank bounty exceeds the program's maximum |
| 6059 | `CreateFeeTooHigh` | no | the create fee exceeds the program's maximum |
| 6060 | `PartnerCutTooHigh` | no | the partner cut must be at most 10000 bps |
| 6061 | `PartnerFeeTooHigh` | no | a partner fee can be at most 100 bps |
| 6062 | `PartnerAccountMissing` | yes | the partner has no token account for the input mint yet; it must be created before a fill |

| 6064 | `MandateInvalid` | no | the mandate's terms are unsound: kinds must be swap, limit or dutch; per-intent cap above the agent fee; total at least the per-intent cap; max intents, max lifetime and floors non-zero; valid until a future time; a partner needs both key and bps; the agent neither empty nor the owner; or the owner has used every grant lane |
| 6065 | `MandateExpired` | no | the mandate has expired; the owner must grant a new one with intent-engine mandate grant |
| 6066 | `MandateKind` | no | the mandate does not allow this kind of intent |
| 6067 | `MandateTtl` | no | the intent lives longer than the mandate allows; choose an earlier expiry within it |
| 6068 | `MandateCap` | no | the intent draws more than the mandate's per-intent cap (amount sold plus agent fee); the owner set that cap, so stay within it or ask the owner, and never split or reword an order to get around it |
| 6069 | `MandateBudget` | no | the mandate's total budget would be exceeded; check what remains with solive_get_mandate, served with --agent |
| 6070 | `MandateCount` | no | the mandate has already created as many intents as it allows |
| 6071 | `MandatePrice` | no | the minimum output is below the price floor the owner set; do not weaken the person's price on your own: tell them the order is cheaper than the owner allows, or ask for at least the floor |
| 6072 | `MandateRevoked` | no | this mandate no longer stands: the owner revoked it, granted that id again, or advanced their signing epoch; the owner must grant a new one |
| 6073 | `MandateMismatch` | no | the intent differs from the mandate's fixed terms: same mints, no flags, the owner's partner only, and proceeds to an account the owner holds |

| 6081 | `MintCapMissing` | no | this create or exit did not pass the input mint's cap account, which the engine needs when it requires caps and whenever escrow it counted leaves; the mint may have no cap yet, in which case the engine accepts no intents selling it |

| 6083 | `MintCapPerOrder` | no | the amount escrowed exceeds the per-order cap the engine set for the input mint; lower the amount |

| 6137 | `PayeeNotAnnouncer` | no | the payee token account does not belong to the wallet that made the announcement; a proof release pays the announcing worker |
| 6138 | `CommitmentMismatch` | no | the opening does not open the announcement's commitment to this work; use the salt and sha256 the announcement commits to |
| 6139 | `AnnouncerNotRecipient` | no | a split release must pay the wallet that made the announcement among its recipients |
| 6140 | `RentRecipientMismatch` | no | rent goes back only to the wallet that paid it; let this server pick the account |
| 6141 | `DeliveryBookOpen` | no | the delivery book of an open escrow stays; close it once the escrow is released, cancelled or expired |
| 6142 | `DeliveryBookLive` | no | the delivery book still holds announcements; close them first |
| 6143 | `RefuteNotPaid` | no | only a paid announcement can be refuted |
| 6144 | `RefuteNotAnnouncer` | no | only the wallet that made the earlier announcement refutes with it |
| 6145 | `RefuteSplitMismatch` | no | the recipients and weights given are not the split the release paid; pass them exactly as the release named them |
| 6146 | `DeliveryRecordKept` | no | a delivery record account is not closed as a legacy account |
| 6147 | `SharesHeld` | yes | a co-author's share of this escrow is still held for it to claim; the escrow and its paid announcement stay until that share is claimed or a year after the escrow expires |
| 6148 | `NoShareHeld` | no | nothing is held for this index of the split; it was paid at release or already claimed |
| 6149 | `HeldSplitMismatch` | no | the recipients and weights given are not the split the release paid, or the signer is not the wallet at that index; pass them exactly as the release named them |
| 6150 | `HolderStandsBy` | no | the wallet holding a job's claim cannot stand by in that job's line; it keeps the claim until it drops it or the claim lapses |
| 6151 | `StakeBelowRent` | no | a claim stake is 0 or at least 0.00089088 SOL, the rent-exempt minimum of a wallet, so the program can always pay a stake back to a wallet that holds nothing; raise the stake or set it to 0 |

## Token programs

| Code | Name | Retry later | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `InsufficientFunds` | no | a token account, or the allowance a signed or agent create draws through, holds less than the amount; lower the amount or fund the account |
| 3 | `MintMismatch` | no | a token account belongs to a different mint than the intent uses |
| 4 | `OwnerMismatch` | no | a token account is not owned by the expected wallet |
| 17 | `AccountFrozen` | yes | a token account is frozen by its issuer; try again once it is thawed |
| 36 | `NoMemo` | no | a token account requires a memo on incoming transfers; its owner must turn that off before it can receive |
| 42 | `CpiGuardTransferBlocked` | no | the owner's token account has CPI Guard on, which stops the engine moving tokens on the owner's signature; turn CPI Guard off, or create a signed intent with intent-engine signed prepare, which draws through the engine's allowance |

## SDK

Every error `@intent-engine/core` and `@intent-engine/client` throw extends `SdkError`, which carries a fixed `code`. Switch on `error.code`, or narrow with `isSdkError(error, code)`; the standard `cause` holds the underlying error, if any.

| Code | Class | Fields | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid-input` | `InvalidInput` | `field`, `rule` | an argument breaks a rule: field names it, rule says which kind of rule |
| `intent-core-error` | `IntentCoreError` | `engineError` | a check that mirrors the engine program refused; engineError names the engine error it would raise |
| `encryption-key-error` | `EncryptionKeyError` | none | an encryption key file is not one profile encryption-key new writes, or its keys do not match |
| `sealed-error` | `SealedError` | none | a sealed file cannot be made or opened: malformed, changed, too many wallets or a key that does not fit |
| `not-invited` | `NotInvited` | `wallet` | none of the keys given is one the file was sealed to |
| `account-version-error` | `AccountVersionError` | `account`, `version`, `current` | an engine account has a layout this SDK does not read; close or migrate it |
| `not-an-engine-account` | `NotAnEngineAccount` | `address` | the account or data is not the engine account the call expects |
| `no-signature` | `NoSignature` | `signer` | a signer returned no signature for the message |
| `missing-account` | `MissingAccount` | `address` | an account the call reads does not exist on this cluster |
| `not-a-mint` | `NotAMint` | `address` | an address passed as a mint is not a token mint |
| `not-deliverable` | `NotDeliverable` | `intent`, `reason` | work cannot be announced to this intent; reason says why |
| `no-message-signer` | `NoMessageSigner` | `worker` | the wallet cannot sign messages, which an announcement needs for its salt and keys |
| `bad-salt-signature` | `BadSaltSignature` | `worker` | the salt signature given is not the worker's signature of the salt message |
| `url-too-long` | `UrlTooLong` | `bytes`, `max`, `recipients` | the work url does not fit one transaction when sealed to this many recipients |
| `announcements-unreadable` | `AnnouncementsUnreadable` | none | the transport cannot list engine accounts, so announcements cannot be read |
| `first-opening-refused` | `FirstOpeningRefused` | `intent`, `reason`, `sha256`, `announcement`, `seq`, `worker`, `sealedTo`, `missing`, `closed`, `holder` | the first announcement that opens, or that opens to the work, cannot be known or cannot be paid; reason says why |
| `not-refutable` | `NotRefutable` | `earlier` | the announcements named cannot refute the release |
| `book-not-closable` | `BookNotClosable` | `intent` | the delivery book of the intent cannot be closed yet |
| `no-free-nonce` | `NoFreeNonce` | `owner` | every nonce in the owner's window is used; advance the window first |
| `no-held-share` | `NoHeldShare` | `announcement`, `wallet`, `reason` | no split share is held for this wallet in the announcement, or it cannot be read; reason says why |
| `not-settleable` | `NotSettleable` | `intent`, `reason` | the intent cannot be released, paid or given feedback this way; reason says why |
| `claim-held-by` | `ClaimHeldBy` | `intent`, `worker`, `until` | another worker holds the job's claim, so only that worker can be paid until it ends |
| `not-fillable` | `NotFillable` | `intent`, `reason` | the intent cannot be filled; reason says why |
| `pay-to-not-wallet` | `PayToNotWallet` | `payTo`, `program` | the payee belongs to a program, not a wallet, so nothing paid to it could be spent |
| `payee-moved` | `PayeeMoved` | `payTo`, `account` | the payee's token account changed hands, so a release would not reach the payee |
| `escrow-expired` | `EscrowExpired` | `intent`, `expiresAt` | the escrow expired; its owner gets it back instead |
| `vote-rejected` | `VoteRejected` | `member`, `intent` | a committee vote is not a valid signature over the release |
| `cosign-rejected` | `CosignRejected` | `wallet`, `intent` | a co-author gave no valid signature over the split release |
| `committee-needed` | `CommitteeNeeded` | `attestor`, `escrow`, `floor` | the escrow reaches the committee floor, so its attestor must be a committee |
| `intent-unreadable` | `IntentUnreadable` | `intent` | a watched intent account could not be decoded; cause holds why |
| `stale-read` | `StaleRead` | `slot`, `seen` | the node answered from a slot older than one the watch already saw |
| `preview-refused` | `PreviewRefused` | none | a preview tried to send; previews send nothing |
| `transport-lacks` | `TransportLacks` | `method` | the transport does not implement a method the call needs |
| `confirm-mismatch` | `ConfirmMismatch` | `field`, `first`, `second` | the second RPC node disagrees with the first or could not be read; nothing was signed or sent |
| `spec-sealed` | `SpecSealed` | `url`, `to`, `keyed` | the spec is sealed to invited wallets and no key given opens it |
| `spec-unreadable` | `SpecUnreadable` | `url` | the spec url could not be fetched or opened |
| `ledger-error` | `LedgerError` | none | the Ledger did not sign; nothing was sent |
| `ledger-path-error` | `LedgerPathError` | none | the text is not a Ledger path this SDK accepts |
| `maybe-sent` | `MaybeSent` | `signature`, `lastValidBlockHeight` | the transaction may have landed; resolve it with client.status(signature, lastValidBlockHeight) and do not send it again |
| `failed-on-chain` | `FailedOnChain` | `signature`, `err`, `program`, `logs`, `engine` | the transaction landed and failed, so its fee was paid and nothing else changed; engine is set when the engine program failed |
| `blockhash-expired` | `BlockhashExpired` | none | the transaction certainly did not land: its blockhash expired; sign it again |
| `behind-min-slot` | `BehindMinSlot` | `slot`, `minContextSlot` | the node answered from a slot older than one already seen; the read is retried |
| `subscription-ended` | `SubscriptionEnded` | `signature`, `reason` | a signature subscription ended without a result; confirmation falls back to polling |
| `not-a-signature` | `NotASignature` | `method` | the RPC node answered method with a value that is not a transaction signature; the call fails and never passes the value on |
| `fetch-failed` | `FetchFailed` | `url`, `reason`, `detail` | a pinned fetch failed: redirect, bad status, network, no address or aborted |
| `mainnet-not-allowed` | `MainnetNotAllowed` | `url` | the url serves mainnet and allowMainnet was not given |
| `profile-history-incomplete` | `ProfileHistoryIncomplete` | `judge` | the judge's profile history could not be read back far enough; nothing was paid |
| `no-key-at-creation` | `NoKeyAtCreation` | `intent` | the Ledger judge's profile named no encryption key when the escrow was made |
| `rate-limited` | `RateLimited` | `method`, `retryAfterMs` | the node rate limited a read and the client was made with retry: false; retryAfterMs is the node's retry-after, or null when it sent none |
| `timed-out` | `TimedOut` | `method`, `timeoutMs` | the node did not answer a call within the client's timeoutMs |
| `cancelled` | `Cancelled` | `method` | the client's signal aborted before this call was issued or answered |
| `transaction-unread` | `TransactionUnread` | `signature` | the node did not serve the transaction, so what it created is unknown |
